answer: To register, an agent locks a share of the mutual insurance pool as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. An agent caught countersigning a transaction never verified is exposed by random spot-checks on the canonical chain. When the proof lands, the entire bond is destroyed at once. The trellis is where slashable funds wait for a verdict. The opal stake is checked each epoch; a sold identity loses standing. The haven is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
